purpose: Every default-selection test launch site that starts Python or passes a prepared command, with how its child is shown not to reach the real application folders. Kept complete by test_run_context_child_sites.py.

dispositions.census: Observed in an ordinary pytest run with the census hook: the child never asked for the real known folders. The census is an acceptance check at the candidate; its receipt names each test that launched a child.
dispositions.tripwire_at_site: The test loads the child tripwire before the child's own program and asserts zero real-adapter calls.
dispositions.guard_built_by_test: The test builds the child's environment to carry the MAIN-5 guard.
dispositions.nested_pytest: The child is a pytest session of this repository and applies the same run context to itself.
dispositions.nested_pytest_passive: The child is a pytest session that executes no repository test.
dispositions.native_helper_only: The child imports only the native job helper.
dispositions.runner_only_plant: The launch is skipped in an ordinary run.
dispositions.non_python: The launched program is not Python.
